items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: Her maiden name was Geringer... Hazel Augustine Geringer.

ctx.x: What's her name now? Let's get it all right.
Her maiden name was Geringer. G-U-E-R-I-G-E-R. The people around here say Geringer. That's the French way of saying it. But the English way is Geringer.
